newsitem.title: USA: UAL cuts U.S. Labor Day fares 60-80 pct.
newsitem.headline: UAL cuts U.S. Labor Day fares 60-80 pct.

text.p: United Airlines said Friday it is cutting air fares from 60 to 80 percent on all of its U.S. domestic flights during the Labor Day holiday.
Some tickets will be as low as $88 roundtrip.
Tickets are available for sale beginning today for travel on August 29, 30, 31, and September 1, 2 only, and are based on seat availability.
Ticketing restrictions include a three-day advance purchase and peak and off-peak fare levels.
United is a subsidiary of UAL Corp.

"Our advance bookings for the summer and fall are strong," said United Senior Vice President-North America Jim Goodwin. "But this sale will stimulate travel throughout the entire Labor Day holiday period and make it more affordable for everyone to fly."
For example, a round-trip fare between Denver and San Francisco is $138, down from $687; between Chicago and Denver is $138, down from $602; and between Chicago and New York is $138, down from $492.
